extension.summary: Browse your Immich photo and video library
extension.description: An unofficial plugin for Immich. Browse your library by month, album, person, place, tag or memory, search it by text or by description, and play it back on your TV. Requires an Immich server and an API key.
extension.news: v2.0.1 - Photo and video rows no longer fall back to a generic icon when a thumbnail has not cached yet. - Fixed videos failing to play from the Timeline, Favourites, People and Tags. - Videos now lists your videos directly, instead of months that open empty. - "Show videos in the timeline" no longer hides videos from Favourites, People and Tags. - A permissions error now says the key lacks a scope, rather than blaming the key. - Connection failures explain themselves: wrong port, timeout, or self-signed certificate. - Timeouts are no longer retried, halving how long a dead server freezes the interface. - Month names are translated instead of always English. - The SSL override, timeout and page size settings are no longer hidden behind Advanced. - Test connection works before both fields are filled in. - Corrected the licence tag to GPL-3.0, matching LICENSE.txt. - Hardened against malformed server responses, and escaped ids in request paths.
